Hi all,

I checked our bank ledger and see an incoming wire with reference NEP-REF-77, but it is 'pending — beneficiary verification' at the correspondent bank. We typically see a 48–72 hour clearance window on these items. If the bank ultimately returns the funds it will post as a failed receipt; if it clears, it'll post under AR code WIR-# and I'll reconcile to invoice 20270331.

To keep Neptune's UX clean while we wait, I propose the following steps (recommended):
1) Issue a provisional goodwill credit for the net overcharge: EUR 11,840 (value-only, no VAT applied) and mark as 'pending credit memo'.
2) Once cash clears, reissue a formal credit memo referencing Neptune's VAT ID and include reverse-charge notation per EU rules (we'll need the VAT certificate to populate the tax details).
3) If the wire returns, we can either reattempt the refund after correcting the beneficiary details or apply the provisional credit as an account balance adjustment per Neptune's instruction.

I've attached a short draft 'provisional-credit-note-draft.pdf' that we can sign and upload to Neptune's account. For the formal credit memo we need:
- Legal entity name exactly as on VAT certificate
- VAT ID (e.g., DE123456789)
- PO reference (PO-55712)

Logan: please mark this for priority in our billing queue and hold collections while we have 'pending' status. Ben — please confirm with Customer Success that application of a provisional credit does not trigger any usage reconciliation automation.

Marissa Cole
Head of Finance Ops, Redwood Inference
